question: Should the reliability_note of dev-services/pulsetic name the pause rules of the vendor help center? help.pulsetic.com/article/217-set-up-your-account says a Free plan account must log in at least once every 90 days to keep it active. help.pulsetic.com/article/352-monitor-paused says an account with no login for more than 3 months is inactive and all its monitors are paused after email alerts, and a monitor offline for more than 7 consecutive days is paused automatically.
why: The reliability_note says no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read, and both articles state a pause that applies to the 10 free monitors. The articles give the threshold as 90 days for the Free plan and as 3 months for every account, so the text must name both and cite both pages.
